info.name: LockSys Mobile API (Semad)
info.description: Sign in (password, OTP, forgot password) and leave (my requests, balances, types) of the Semad ERP. Run the folders in order: folder 1 fills the token used by the rest. Password reset/change requests change a real password: use a test user. While EXPOSE_DEV_OTP=1 the OTP request returns devCode and otpCode is filled automatically.

item.name: Approved in a year, page of 5
Preview a leave (counts days, checks rules, saves nothing)
Create a leave request (writes a real row)
Annual leave without 7 days notice -> 422 ADVANCE_NOTICE
Type not allowed in the app -> 422 TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED
Today: my sites, work areas and state
Month summary (a month, day by day)

exec: const d=pm.response.json().data;pm.test("every day has a known status",()=>d.days.forEach(x=>pm.expect(["PRESENT","ABSENT","OFF","LEAVE","MISSION","TODAY","FUTURE"]).to.include(x.status)));

item.name: Check in / out (the server decides which; writes a real row)

exec: pm.test("201 or a clear refusal",()=>{pm.expect([201,403,409]).to.include(pm.response.code);});pm.test("201 has the time",()=>{if(pm.response.code===201){pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.time).to.match(/^\d\d:\d\d$/);}});

item.name: Later (an earlier stage must decide first)
Approve (writes; needs the earlier stages done) -> 200 or 409 WAIT_PREVIOUS
